items.text: I’m fighting to protect our four-legged friends from abuse. I’m championing the bipartisan Goldie’s Act and Puppy Protection Act to shut down cruel and inhumane treatment at puppy mills. Share a photo of your sweet pup if you’re with me! https://t.co/IpEoENusxy

“Every Person, Every Family, Every Community.”

September is National Recovery Month. Treatment can save lives. We can come together and ensure everyone suffering from addiction has a chance at a full recovery. We are in this together. https://t.co/OW60sEsEIv
It’s that time of year again! Don’t forget to turn your clocks back and soak up the extra hour of sleep! https://t.co/8zf3mqqw1x

Too many Iowans endure pain daily that keeps them from doing every day tasks - like working, playing children, or household chores. I’m leading bipartisan legislation to develop new treatment options and provide relief to those suffering from chronic pain! https://t.co/tYqCUN97A0

More than 51 million Americans suffer from chronic pain that prevents them from doing everyday tasks. My new, bipartisan bill will help promote new treatment options and enhance research to improve quality of life for those who are suffering. https://t.co/t3O0aYh6Tw

1 in 5 Americans live in chronic pain that prevents them from completing everyday tasks – like working, taking care of their children, or household chores. That’s why I helped introduce legislation to improve treatment options for those suffering. Read:
https://t.co/sy2i8BmoNv

My bipartisan bill, the Chronic Pain Act, will improve chronic pain care by promoting new treatment options for those who are suffering.

https://t.co/1inU4Fsazh

Excited to announce I secured a $2.5 million federal investment for a new water treatment facility in Bondurant, ensuring reliable water access to our community. This investment is a step towards improving clean water access and a healthier future. https://t.co/U1y5N47biX

Last week, I was proud to announce a $2.5 million federal investment for Bondurant's new water treatment facility alongside Mayor Elrod. This investment is critical to ensuring the city can meet the current and future water demands of the community and its residents. https://t.co/6vje7v43XW
Our nation is facing both a mental health and substance abuse crisis. Occupational therapists can make a massive difference in treatment and recovery from these diagnoses.
This commonsense legislation will reduce barriers to treatment for Medicare recipients, expanding their options for healthcare for mental health and substance abuse disorders. https://t.co/WRFSySNfNu
In Congress, I’m fighting to support Medicare. This week, I helped introduce bipartisan legislation to reduce barriers to treatment for Medicare beneficiaries - check it out! https://t.co/ptSkyuYK0h

The Walnut Creek Family YMCA has been a cornerstone of the West Des Moines community for more than 40 years. We just announced a $1.8 million federal investment to improve the health and wellness of individuals in the community and expand the youth development programming. https://t.co/ybjBBGpHfd

🚰 In 2021, water treatment systems in California and Florida were compromised when hackers attempted to poison water systems with insufficient cybersecurity measures. We cannot risk that happening to Iowa's water systems.

Right now - Iowans can’t use their nutrition benefits to purchase hot, prepared foods like rotisserie chicken, hot sandwiches, and soup. That’s why I’m fighting to change this archaic law to help working parents put healthy, filling meals on the table for their children. https://t.co/X5eJjxYPso

Almost everyone knows someone affected by breast cancer. I cosponsored the Metastatic Breast Cancer Access to Care Act to ensure Medicare beneficiaries have early access to the treatment they need to fight back and survive their diagnosis. https://t.co/quWqmgjjU3

Too many Iowans know someone who has been affected by the fentanyl crisis. I’m cosponsoring bipartisan legislation to ensure emergency rooms are testing for fentanyl when patients come in with overdose symptoms. https://t.co/rKxgffXWry

Almost all of us know someone impacted by breast cancer. This Breast Cancer Awareness Month, I’m championing the Metastatic Breast Cancer Access to Care Act to help ensure early access to life-saving treatment for Medicare patients. https://t.co/b8KBW1uDQi

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month, & I'm proud to have worked across the aisle to support life-saving bills like the Metastatic Breast Cancer Access to Care Act. We must continue fighting for better care & breakthroughs for patients & survivors. https://t.co/CxC8dDx3ZS

I’m fully committed to protecting  Social Security and Medicare. Over the past two years, I’ve taken action to safeguard these critical programs:
✅Preventing politicians from playing games with your benefits
✅Expanding Medicare coverage
✅Increasing access to telehealth
✅Fighting to train more nurses

Healthcare access is critical for all Iowans, and I’m committed to ensuring everyone can access the care they need::
✅Investing $2 million for rural dialysis care
✅Expanding Medicare coverage
✅Cutting drug costs
✅Improving rural telehealth access
✅Fighting the nursing shortage
✅Investing in mental health services

We secured $2 million in federal funding to build a new dialysis center at Wayne County Hospital! This investment will expand critical healthcare access for patients across six counties. https://t.co/BQwi4WTNv6

In 2024, we fought to improve healthcare for Iowans. From expanding telehealth access to tackling the nursing shortage and securing critical funding for local hospitals and mental health centers, I’ll always work to ensure healthcare is accessible and affordable. https://t.co/Usd09AWpkH

Our law enforcement officers risk their lives every day to keep us safe. I cosponsored the Improving Law Enforcement Officer Safety & Wellness Through Data Act to ensure officers can access the resources needed to support their mental health. https://t.co/yMG8eXIo2w

Iowans deserve the flexibility to use their nutrition benefits on warm, ready-to-eat meals that make life a little easier - especially for working parents. That’s why I introduced bipartisan legislation, the Hot Foods Act, to let families use SNAP benefits to buy warm, ready-to-eat meals.
